objections.reason: Same concept as T083 (sunyata); 'kesunyataan' is an inconsistent variant of the term.
'Pariwara' in modern Indonesian means advertisement, not retinue; 'pengiring' conveys the sense.
Tibetan mya ngan las 'das means beyond sorrow; inconsistent with T060 and T211 which use kesedihan.
Same term as T081 (kehausan); 'hasrat' is also used for kāma in T067, causing a clash.
Inconsistent with T077 (ākāśa = ruang); 'ruang hampa' means vacuum.
Use the standard spelling bodhicitta, consistent with bodhisatwa.
Use the standard spelling bodhicitta, consistent with bodhisatwa.
'Marga' means clan name in everyday Indonesian; 'jalan' is also used in the title and is clear.
Approved English children's rendering is 'Blessed One'; 'Bhagawan' is not understandable to children and is the Hindu-style form.
Kṣaṇa is the 'leisure' half of T195 (keluangan dan kelengkapan); 'kesempatan' means opportunity and breaks the pair.
'Perendahan' is not idiomatic Indonesian; 'celaan' correctly conveys smod pa (disparaging, criticizing).
Names are given without diacritics elsewhere (Manjusri, Ksitigarbha); keep one orthography in Indonesian text.
